newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT -Gilts to drift down towards 109-08.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT -Gilts to drift down towards 109-08.

text.p: British gilts will likely drift down towards support around 109-10,08 on Tuesday, with technical analysts suggesting selling into any rallies from here.
A lack of economic data will likely leave the market scrabbling for direction, they added.
"Unless something mad happens in other markets, it's hard to see why we're going to get any fireworks in gilts," said Andy Cossor, fixed income analyst at Technical Data here.
"For choice, given the way the market has been performing lately, selling into strength would be preferred."
By 0707 GMT, June gilts were down 2/32 at 109-12.
Cossor said the contract would be confined to a narrow range, with Monday's high of 109-25 likely capping the upside and 109-08 propping up the downside.
But if the contract does make a break to the upside, it will soon run into further resistance at 109-31, 110-00, Cossor said.
Traders on LIFFE were fairly bearish on the June gilt near term. They noted good intraday support at 109-10,08 but said market indicators suggested downside pressure had returned.
"I expect this level to be broken in the near future with declines then back overall towards the 108-08, the figure area," said Carol Harmer, a trader and technical analyst on LIFFE.
She said there could be a bounce from 109-10,08, but rallies wuold be short lived and she advised selling into strength around 109-18,21.
Cossor noted a head and shoulders pattern with a bottom around 108-05 may be forming on the June gilt chart, but added it was too early to be sure.
"Head and shoulders take a long time to form so I'll keep it in mind, but I'm not betting on it," he said.
By 0720 GMT, June short sterling was down one basis point at 93.39.
